scope: The region/freehand capture leaf and its painter, Pointer-Event stylus handling with palm rejection, the cropped lazy OCR seam, the 0.70 confidence gate, and the canvas-leaf stories (Default, Empty, ManyStrokes >=200 points, DarkTheme). Out of scope: rasterizing ink for Tesseract; OCR of a whole page; the leader-import review screen (021); the ink pad (024); colour-mask detection (021 rung 2).

acceptance_criteria.text: I17 and I18 pass: imperative Konva (batchDraw / new Konva.* / getLayer) appears only in the painter, and the painter imports no @feature/* and no @shared/config/*.

Scrolling works whenever no draw tool is active: touch-action is toggled to none only while a draw tool is armed, and pointerType==='pen' palm rejection ignores touch while the pen is active; both are unit-testable.
No whole-page OCR call exists: shared/lib/ocr.ts only accepts a cropped CanvasImageSource plus a pixel crop rect, and is imported lazily.
A 0.69 OCR confidence is excluded from result input; 0.70 is the inclusive boundary of confidence.
Both the ManyStrokes (>=200 points) and DarkTheme stories render in the 'stories' story-test run alongside Default and Empty.

open_questions: Q5 (defaulted: Storybook stories for canvas leaves, fixture strokes) — g5 follows the default: Default, Empty, ManyStrokes, DarkTheme.

Q8 (unanswered: the real tablet mix) — does not change the code, only the on-device gate measurement (60 fps with 200 points). Implemented against the documented default; the hardware pass is deferred as a follow-up, exactly as task 009's gate check was.

Q9 (unanswered: assume a pen; verify) — g2 implements the documented default ('assume a pen; finger must still work') with Pointer Events and pointerType==='pen'; the human still has to verify the real fleet.

NEW-1: the plan's §4 says 'marquee + freehand ink leaves' (plural) and §2 g1 says 'marquee + freehand ink leaves', but the blueprint's canvasLeaves lists exactly one active leaf, `marquee` (04 §5.2 also lists only marquee). No separate freehand-ink leaf exists, so both tools (rectangle marquee and freehand lasso) live inside the one `marquee` leaf. Recorded as a decision, not a silent pick; if a second leaf was intended, the blueprint must gain it first.
risks: Stroke points in React state drop frames (fa §3) — mitigated by keeping the in-flight stroke in a ref and drawing it from the painter's rAF loop; only the committed stroke touches state.
motion on a Konva node (I20) — no motion import under shared/components/canvas/**; the marquee leaf animates nothing.

OCR on handwriting is weak (spec §5.4: never rasterize ink for Tesseract; on-line recognition beats OCR) — the 0.70 gate marks a weak crop needs-correction and excludes it from any Result, protecting the Result, not the note.
Tesseract downloads worker + traineddata at first use; the seam must be lazy and must fail soft (return an empty, below-gate result) so a page with no text layer still saves a mark offline.
